text: The induction principle for the natural numbers in MLTT is the dependent eliminator with motive:
choices: P : ℕ → Type (a type family over ℕ)
P : ℕ → ℕ (a function on naturals)
explanation: The ℕ eliminator has motive P:ℕ→U (a type family). For the base: d₀:P(0); for the step: dₛ:Π(n:ℕ).P(n)→P(S n). This unifies recursion (P constant) and induction (P propositions).
